title: The Whole Ladder

sections.name: Listen
lines: One step, two steps, up we go,
Eight little steps from high to low.
C at the bottom, C at the top,
Climb the whole ladder, never stop.

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Every step a different sound,
Higher, higher, off the ground.
Count them with me, one to eight,
Climbing up, we're doing great.

sections.name: Together
lines: Climb with me, step by step,
C, E, G, and up we've stepped.
High C, then G, and E, then C,
The whole ladder, you and me.

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Look how high our voices go,
Wave to everyone below.
Top of the ladder, what a view,
Every note is up to you.

sections.name: All together
lines: Now we know the ladder well,
Every step, a little bell.
C at the bottom, C at the top,
The whole ladder, hop, hop, hop!

title: Lift Goes Up

sections.name: Listen
lines: Press the button, ding, ding, ding,
Up the lift goes, hear it sing.
Floor one, floor three, floor five, too,
Top floor, top floor, peekaboo!

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Doors go open, doors go shut,
Up we zoom, and that is what
Makes my tummy go so funny,
Lift goes up, the sky is sunny.

sections.name: Together
lines: Ride with me, up we go,
E, G, B, and high C, oh!
Ding, ding, ding, the top floor's here,
Wave hello and give a cheer.

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Grandpa holds my hand so tight,
Little lift, you're just right.
Every floor a brand-new view,
Lift goes up, and we go too.

sections.name: All together
lines: Now the lift goes down, down, down,
Back to the floor at the bottom of town.
Ding, ding, ding, the doors are wide,
What a lovely lift-up ride!

title: Up the Mountain

sections.name: Listen
lines: Up the mountain, step by step,
Boots on, water bottle, yep!
Higher, higher, past the trees,
Feel the cool and gentle breeze.

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Goats go hopping, rock to rock,
Tick tock, tick tock, goes the clock.
Nearly there and nearly done,
Top of the mountain, top in the sun.

sections.name: Together
lines: Climb with me, G, A, B,
High C, high C, can you see?
Clouds below and sky above,
Mountain air is what we love.

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Pack a snack and share it round,
Sitting on the highest ground.
Echo, echo, shout hello,
Echo answers from below.

sections.name: All together
lines: Down the mountain, slow and steady,
Dinner's waiting, are you ready?
Up the mountain, what a day,
We'll come back another day.

title: Bird on the Top Branch

sections.name: Listen
lines: Little bird,
Top of the tree.
Sing a song,
Down to me.

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Tweet, tweet, tweet,
High and sweet.
Hop, hop, hop,
Right at the top.

sections.name: Together
lines: Sing with me,
Up in the tree.
High C, high,
Touch the sky.

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Morning sun,
Day's begun.
Wings spread wide,
Off you glide.

sections.name: All together
lines: Goodnight, bird,
Not a word.
Top of the tree,
Sleep, like me.

lyrics:

title: Bubbles Rising

sections.name: Listen
lines: Blow a bubble, watch it rise,
Floating up to sunny skies.
Up and up and up it goes,
Pop! It landed on my nose!

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Big ones, small ones, round and bright,
Rainbow colours in the light.
Chase them, catch them, one, two, three,
Bubbles, bubbles, fly with me.

sections.name: Together
lines: Blow with me, C, D, E,
F and G, so high and free.
Bubbles rising, up they float,
Every bubble, one more note.

sections.name: One more verse
lines: In the bath and in the park,
Bubbles even after dark.
Bubble beard and bubble hat,
Bubble on the sleepy cat!

sections.name: All together
lines: Last big bubble, up it flies,
Higher than the butterflies.
Pop, pop, pop, the bubbles end,
Blow some more tomorrow, friend!

Blow some more tomorrow, friend!

title: Hot Air Balloon

sections.name: Listen
lines: Big balloon, red and blue,
Room for me and room for you.
Up we float above the town,
Little houses looking down.

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Fields of green and rivers wide,
What a gentle, floating ride.
Birds fly past and wave hello,
Slowly, slowly, off we go.

sections.name: Together
lines: Float with me, low to high,
G to C up in the sky.
Big balloon, so round and bright,
Floating in the morning light.

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Over hills and over trees,
Drifting on the cosy breeze.
Clouds like pillows, soft and white,
Hold the basket, hold on tight.

sections.name: All together
lines: Down we come, the ride is through,
Thank you, sky, so big and blue.
Big balloon, what a view,
Let's go up again, me and you.

title: Climbing Frame

sections.name: Listen
lines: Climbing frame in the park,
Up we go before it's dark.
Hands and feet and hold on tight,
Climbing up with all my might.

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Monkey bars and swing so high,
Slide comes down from near the sky.
Friends are waiting, take your turn,
So many things to try and learn.

sections.name: Together
lines: Climb with me, E, F, G,
A, then G, as high as me.
Up the frame and down the slide,
Playground fun, side by side.

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Mumma's watching from the bench,
Papa found a muddy trench.
Climb, climb, climb and wave hello,
Down the slide, and off we go!

sections.name: All together
lines: Time for home, the sun is low,
Wave goodbye and off we go.
Climbing frame, we'll see you soon,
Maybe on another afternoon.

title: Stars Up High

sections.name: Listen
lines: Stars up high, way up high,
Little lights across the sky.
Twinkle here and twinkle there,
Stars are shining everywhere.

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Moon is smiling, round and white,
Saying gently, sleep tight.
Close your eyes and count them slow,
One, two, three, the stars all glow.

sections.name: Together
lines: Sing with me, soft and low,
G, A, B, then high C, oh.
Stars up high, way up high,
Sing a sleepy lullaby.

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Every star a little friend,
Shining till the night will end.
Wish upon the brightest one,
Wait until the morning sun.

sections.name: All together
lines: Stars up high, goodnight now,
Sleepy stars all take a bow.
Twinkle, twinkle, soft and slow,
Sweet dreams, little one, below.

title: Top of the Ladder

sections.name: Listen
lines: Top of the ladder, here we are,
Every note a shining star.
From the bottom to the top,
Now we sing and never stop!

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Every song we learned along,
Every step became a song.
Three notes, five notes, six, then eight,
Look at us, we're doing great!

sections.name: Together
lines: Jump with me, G and C,
High C, high C, one, two, three.
Top of the ladder, wave your hands,
We're the biggest little band!

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Ba and Dada, clap along,
Cousins, sing the ladder song.
Big and small and all the rest,
Every player is the best.

sections.name: All together
lines: Top of the ladder, take a bow,
We can play the whole thing now.
From the bottom to the top,
Top of the ladder, hip hip hop!
